summary: Import thunk for the Winsock recvfrom() function. Forwards (s, buf, len, flags, from, fromlen) unchanged to the __imp_recvfrom import (0x0059E2E0) and returns the integer receive result. Called by the network receive path: NetworkPacketReceive (00561E30), sub_563410 and sub_563AB0.

local_names.s: socket handle passed through to the recvfrom import
local_names.buf: receive buffer passed through to the recvfrom import
local_names.len: buffer length passed through to the recvfrom import
local_names.flags: flags passed through to the recvfrom import
local_names.from: source sockaddr pointer passed through to the recvfrom import
local_names.fromlen: in/out source address length passed through to the recvfrom import
